messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Common Side Effects:
The possible side effects of hydrocodone and acetaminophen are constipation, nausea, sleepiness, vomiting, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and abdominal pain.
Call your healthcare provider if you have any of these symptoms and symptoms are severe.
Get emergency medical help if you have:
Trouble breathing
Shortness of breath
Fast heartbeat
Chest pain
Swelling of your face, tongue, or throat
Extreme drowsiness
Light-headedness when changing positions
Feeling faint
Agitation
High body temperature
Trouble walking
Stiff muscles
Mental changes such as confusion.
These are not all the possible side effects of hydrocodone and acetaminophen.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen", "has reporting instruction", "report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088"]

The relation 'has reporting instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the action or guidance specified by the object entity to be followed for reporting side effects or adverse events.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has reporting contact': The subject drug has a designated contact entity specified by the object for reporting side effects or adverse events.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires prescriptions to be reported to': The subject entity mandates that prescriptions for the drug be reported to the object entity.
D. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
E. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
